k01-wind.note: A trained rat sheltering in a chink of the ring wall while the wind blows over the crown.

scene.prompt: Turn [image 1], a rough 3D blockout, into a photorealistic dusk photograph with the same camera and composition, Hellenistic Greece, 3rd century BC. None of its smooth surfaces survive: real limestone, dry-stone, earth, scrub. At dusk in a strong wind, the foot of a small ruined cyclopean dry-stone wall: huge rough stones with dark chinks between them, dry grass and scrub streaming flat in the wind. In one chink sits a single brown rat, tucked in out of the wind, a thin cord knotted round its neck with a tiny bronze tube. It does not move. No people, no fire. Everything sharp.

scene.prompt: Turn [image 1], a rough 3D blockout, into a photorealistic dusk photograph with the same camera and composition, Hellenistic Greece, 3rd century BC. None of its smooth surfaces survive: real limestone, dry-stone, earth, scrub; blob trees become real pines. A lookout post on a steep slope among pale crags, a low rough dry-stone breastwork of uneven loose stones in front, dry grass streaming flat in a strong wind. [image 2] is a reference board: copy its bandit's dress exactly (saffron orange tunic and cloak, bronze bracers). He sits alone behind the breastwork, head and shoulders above it, one hand on a small papyrus scroll, partly unrolled, on the stones; on the near top stones of the breastwork, clearly visible in the lower foreground, ONE brown rat sitting still, a thin cord knotted round its neck holding a tiny bronze tube, sheltering in a gap between stones. No hut, no building, no roof anywhere: only crags, scrub and the breastwork. No fire, no other people. Nothing modern.
